baseline.conclusion: The symptom is real on the same-document SPA tab. Native volume facts exist in the DOM and in trusted events, but the content side never publishes an observation for them; a Popup read or a reload is what re-establishes the path.

rootCause.mechanism: The document-start bootstrap hears EVERY native volumechange in the document capture phase, but yields the whole document as soon as state.runtimeObservesMedia is true. That flag only means the heavy runtime registered SOME player. On a same-document SPA route the audible successor player is mounted after that handoff and is not in the runtime registry, so its volumechange has no publisher. The runtime's own `!selected` branch cannot help because it only fires for elements the registry registered.
rootCause.whyTheTwoReportedWorkaroundsFit: A Popup button performs an explicit read / extension intent that re-establishes the snapshot; a reload rebuilds the document, the registry and the epoch (baseline shows volumeBase=75 / media:1:1 immediately after reload).
rootCause.whyEarlierRoundsMissedIt: Prior probes sampled the ACTIVE _blank live tab, where the player is registered in the top frame and the defect does not reproduce. Earlier /follow attempts were also invalid (unsigned profile copies, wrong tab, hover-only slider not expanded). See [void samples](./2026-11-15-follow-live-badge-probe-environment.json) and [real-route proof](./2026-11-15-follow-live-badge-real-route.json).
